Frequently asked questions

What is a makeup AR SDK?

It is a software kit that lets brands add virtual makeup try-on features to apps, websites, or in-store systems.

In what way does it operate for customers?

As your customer showcases their face on a real-time live video, the SDK detects and overlays the virtual  makeup on their face in reality.

Do brands need advanced coding skills?

No. But sometimes, developer effort might be needed in some aspects.

Can it run on any device?

No. It depends on the operating system, browser, hardware performance and SDK compatibility.

Why should a beauty brand use it?

It increases sales, decreases returns, and makes shopping more fun for your customers.

Is the makeup AR SDK accurate with colors?

Yes. But it depends on the lighting, camera quality and sometimes, the SDK algorithms.

About GlamAR

GlamAR is a B2B SaaS digital platform that provides 3D, AR & VR solutions and powers businesses to improve engagement, reduce returns, and increase conversions in retail. Basically, we have in-house 3D model creation, product configurator, virtual AR try-on in multiple categories, virtual store creator, AI skin analysis, etc., to promote your customer engagement.

You can integrate GlamAR services in your existing website and in-store screens to give your shoppers a personal experience that keeps them informed about the product. Beauty brands, fashion brands, eyewear brands, accessories brands, lifestyle brands, and online stores can use GlamAR.

GlamAR's solutions

Many retail brands can use the GlamAR solutions to promote their businesses.

1. 3D solution

  • 3D model creation: This feature is used by GlamAR to help you create high-quality 3D models that accurately represent product images.
  • 360-degree product viewer: It enables shoppers to explore your products from every angle. This feature is responsible for the spinning and rotating of your products for a complete view, which will help to reduce product returns.
  • 3D product configurator: The 3D configurator allows your customers to design the specific features that are available in your catalogue. It lets your customers customize colors and finishes in real time.
  • 3D virtual photography: This feature helps you save on production costs. Instead of photographing every product image, GlamAR can change colors without taking new pictures.

2. AR solution

  • Virtual try-ons: The virtual try-on feature allows shoppers to try on different wearable products such as makeup, eyewear, accessories, jewelry, nails, and watches with just their smartphone or desktop cameras.
  • Realistic 3D rendering: This feature is responsible for placing a 3D image of your products in your customer's image so they see how it’ll appear in real life. It also contains adjustable intensity and color options.
  • Interactive AR: Instead of just staring at static photos of your products, GlamAR has made it an option to create an interactive advertisement using augmented reality to display your product items for better engagement.
  • AI facial skin analysis: GlamAR gives your users access to scan their skin for skin conditions. Users can monitor and analyze up to 14+ skin conditions, such as hydration, texture, and acne.

3. VR solution 

  • Virtual store or space platform: GlamAR can set up a virtual store that operates around the clock. The virtual store helps you manage inventories, track sales, and create an interactive shopping environment accessible from anywhere.
  • Personalized shopping: This feature makes the product selection process easier for shoppers. After a try-on process, customers are presented with suggestions to meet their needs.
  • Virtual events: Beyond the physical walls, you can create an immersive and interactive virtual experience that enables your customers to interact with or relate to your product's items just like they would in real life.

Industries & brands that can benefit from GlamAR 

A large number of industries can adopt GlamAR’s solution. Here’s a breakdown of the industries that can benefit from GlamAR:

1. Beauty & cosmetics industries 

The beauty and cosmetic industry is one of the significant industries that can benefit from GlamAR. Beauty and cosmetic brands can allow customers to virtually test makeup products like lipstick, eyeshadow, and foundation. Shoppers also have access to AI-powered skin diagnostics and AI beauty filters.

2. Eyewear & accessories sectors

Eyewear brands can utilize GlamAR’s virtual try-on to allow their customers to try on eyewear, including sunglasses and eyeglasses. The accessories brands can also use GlamAR to enable their customers to try on the experience of their accessories, like hats and caps.

3. Jewelry industry 

Jewelry brands are one of GlamAR’s major clients. GlamAR enables its customers to virtually try on jewelry items such as earrings, necklaces, bracelets, rings, and watches. The virtual try-on can overlay the chosen jewelry on the customer's body so that they see how it fits.

4. Hair & nail making industries. 

GlamAR also caters to the hair and nail sector. The system supports try-ons for hairstyles for both males and females of different ages. The virtual try-on for nails allows shoppers to try on different nail polish shades before applying them to their nails.

5. Fashion & wearables sectors

GlamAR's reach expands into the fashion industry, and it allows shoppers to try on virtual fashion products such as shoes, caps, and other wearables. Augmented reality can be used to try on fashion products.

6. Retail & e-commerce sectors

GlamAR works closely with retail brands and e-commerce platforms to help them create a shopping environment that is immersive. GlamAR is also known for assisting retail brands in creating virtual stores, online spaces, and virtual events. 

7. Marketing & ad agencies

GlamAR also helps marketing agencies to create AR-powered advertising solutions to market products. GlamAR creates 3D models that brands use to create an interactive ad platform for marketing purposes.

GlamAR’s features

GlamAR’s features are meant to give your customers the whole experience of your products. The features GlamAR offers include

1. AR solution

This solution gives your shoppers access to try on products like makeup, eyewear, jewelry, furniture, and accessories right from their space. The AR tech empower your customers to try-on these products on themselves in real-time or on any 3D models created. It can be activated by using any device camera of their choice. Hence, this gives room for a personalized and better shopping experience.

2. AI facial skin analysis 

The AI facial skin analysis tool can be used by beauty care shoppers to analyze the user's face for skin conditions such as texture, hydration, fine lines, and pigmentation, and then recommend skincare products to address these concerns.

3. Multiple product try-on

The multi-try-on feature allows your users to try on more than one product at a time. A customer can apply lipstick, mascara, and eyeliner at the same time to see how they complement each other.

4. AI recommendations

The AI recommendation feature gives your users product suggestions after a product try-on. The recommendations are typically based on your user behavior and skin tone.

5. Enterprise-grade security

GlamAR ensures that your customers' data is protected with enterprise-grade safeguards. GlamAR is compliant with SOC 2, ISO 27001, and GDPR standards.

5. Seamless and personalized experiences
